title: sonar_tracks
description: One tracked target in public.sonar_tracks. A row is one passage through the beam, not a sound event and not a confirmed fish until review_status is confirmed. direction is upstream, downstream, or milling. species_id is null when the classifier abstains. species_confidence is a 0-1 score, not a calibrated probability unless the model card says so. clip_path, when set, is an object key in the Storage bucket sonar. features is a track summary, not an ARIS frame. review_status defaults to unreviewed. Realtime is enabled on this table. Inserts use the service role.

speed_mps.description: Track speed in metres per second.

clip_path.description: Object key in bucket sonar, or null.

features.description: Classifier inputs derived from the track. Synthetic rows set synthetic=true. behavior is surface_cluster, school, solitary, or unknown.
